# Tekivex

> Tekivex is an independently built platform of free developer tools for JavaScript and TypeScript. Every product is free for commercial use, framework-agnostic, accessibility-first, and production-tested. Built and maintained by the Tekivex Engineering team. Official site: https://www.tekivex.com.

## Products
- [GridStorm](https://www.tekivex.com/product/gridstorm) (npm: `gridstorm`): Headless, framework-agnostic high-performance data grid. Virtual scrolling for 100K+ rows at 60fps, 42 Excel-compatible formula functions, Excel copy/paste, 35+ composable plugins, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, React/Vue/Svelte/Angular adapters, <50KB core. MIT-licensed, free for commercial use.
- [Tekivex UI](https://www.tekivex.com/product/tekivex-ui) (npm: `tekivex-ui`): Accessible React/Vue/Svelte component library: 100+ components (Tkx-prefixed), WCAG 2.1 AA (targeting AAA), dark/light/high-contrast themes via CSS custom properties, tree-shakeable ESM, headless primitives. MIT-licensed, free for commercial use.
- [Quantum Vault](https://www.tekivex.com/product/quantum-vault) (npm: `@sigvault/sdk`): Sovereign, self-hosted post-quantum token issuance, validation, and rotation using NIST-standardized CRYSTALS-Dilithium (ML-DSA-87 / FIPS 204) signatures with XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted payloads and a HYDRA mutation chain for replay protection. Apache-2.0.
- [Pyntra](https://www.tekivex.com/product/pyntra): Free, hosted browser-based PDF editor (use it live at https://pyntra.tekivex.com — nothing to install). Fill and add form fields, sign, stamp, annotate, redact, and open encrypted PDFs entirely client-side; files are never uploaded.
- [Analytics Studio](https://www.tekivex.com/product/analytics-studio): Free, hosted browser-based BI app (use it live at https://analytics.tekivex.com — nothing to install). Drag-and-drop pivot tables, 26+ chart types, KPI dashboards, and an in-browser SQL engine, with no backend required.
- [DataFlow](https://www.tekivex.com/product/dataflow): Free, hosted browser-based real-time streaming dashboard (use it live at https://dataflow.tekivex.com/stocks — nothing to install). Live feeds with directional change highlighting, anomaly alerts, backpressure control, and time-travel replay.

## Guides & use cases
- [How to Merge PDF Files for Free Without Uploading Them](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-merge-pdf-free): A step-by-step guide to combining PDF files into one document entirely in your browser — no upload, no watermark, no account. Includes ordering, common pitfalls, and encrypted-PDF notes.
- [How to Split a PDF and Extract Pages in Your Browser](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-split-pdf-extract-pages): Extract a single page, a range, or any combination of pages from a PDF for free and privately. Learn the page-range syntax and how to avoid the mistakes that trip people up.
- [How to Convert JPG or PNG Images to a PDF, Privately](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-convert-jpg-to-pdf): Turn photos and scans into a single PDF without uploading them anywhere — ideal for IDs, receipts, and documents. Covers image order, page sizing, and unsupported formats like HEIC.
- [How to Compress a PDF to a Smaller File Size (Free, No Upload)](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-compress-pdf): Shrink a large PDF so it fits an email or upload limit — in your browser, with an honest look at what compression can and cannot do, and why scanned PDFs shrink most.
- [How to Make a Chart from a CSV File (and Share It Privately)](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-make-chart-from-csv): Turn a spreadsheet export into a clean bar, line, area, or donut chart in seconds, download it as SVG or PNG, and share a link whose data never touches a server.
- [Why In-Browser Tools Keep Your Files Private (No Upload, Explained)](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/why-browser-tools-keep-files-private): Most online PDF and file tools upload your document to their servers. Here is what "runs in your browser" actually means, why it is more private, and how to tell the difference.
- [How to Convert a PDF to JPG Images, Privately](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-convert-pdf-to-jpg): A step-by-step guide to turning each page of a PDF into a JPG or PNG image entirely in your browser — no upload, no watermark. Covers when to pick JPG vs PNG and common pitfalls.
- [How to Rotate a PDF and Fix Sideways Pages (Free, No Upload)](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-rotate-pdf): A step-by-step guide to rotating PDF pages 90°, 180° or 270° and saving the corrected file in your browser — no quality loss, no upload. Includes how to rotate a single page.
- [How to Delete Pages from a PDF (Free, in Your Browser)](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/how-to-delete-pages-from-pdf): A step-by-step guide to removing unwanted pages from a PDF — single pages, ranges, or a mix — and downloading the trimmed file, all in your browser with no upload and no watermark.
- [How GridStorm Renders 100K Rows at 60fps](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/gridstorm-virtual-scrolling-60fps): A deep dive into GridStorm’s virtual scrolling engine: windowing, row recycling, and the render budget that keeps 100,000+ rows smooth at 60fps.
- [GridStorm vs AG Grid: Feature Comparison and Migration Guide](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/gridstorm-vs-ag-grid-migration): A practical, honest comparison of GridStorm and AG Grid — licensing, bundle size, plugins, accessibility — plus a step-by-step migration path.
- [Building a Real-Time Financial Trading Grid with GridStorm](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/gridstorm-financial-trading-grid): How to build a high-frequency trading blotter with GridStorm: streaming cell updates, flash highlighting, conditional formatting, and frozen columns.
- [Inside GridStorm’s 35-Plugin Architecture](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/gridstorm-plugin-architecture): GridStorm ships a headless core and 35 composable plugins. Here is how the plugin system works and how to build your own.
- [Excel-Compatible Formulas in GridStorm: 42 Functions in the Browser](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/gridstorm-excel-formulas): GridStorm implements 42 Excel-compatible formula functions with a real dependency graph and copy/paste type coercion. Here is how the formula engine works.
- [Making Data Grids WCAG-Accessible with GridStorm](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/gridstorm-accessible-data-grid): Data grids are notoriously hard to make accessible. GridStorm’s a11y plugin delivers WCAG 2.1 AA — keyboard nav, ARIA grid roles, and screen-reader support.
- [Post-Quantum Tokens Explained: ML-DSA-87 (Dilithium) in Quantum Vault](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/quantum-vault-post-quantum-tokens-explained): What post-quantum tokens are, why Q-Day threatens today’s cryptography, and how Quantum Vault uses NIST-standardised CRYSTALS-Dilithium (ML-DSA-87 / FIPS 204) signatures to stay safe.
- [Migrating Token Issuance to Post-Quantum Crypto with Quantum Vault](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/quantum-vault-migrate-pqc-token-issuance): A migration playbook for moving JWT/RSA-style token issuance to quantum-resistant signatures using Quantum Vault, with a hybrid transition strategy.
- [Sovereign, Self-Hosted Token Verification with Quantum Vault](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/quantum-vault-sovereign-token-verification): Why sovereignty matters for cryptographic infrastructure and how to run self-hosted, no-third-party-trust token issuance and verification with Quantum Vault.
- [Tekivex UI vs MUI vs Chakra: An Honest Comparison](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/tekivex-ui-vs-mui-chakra): How Tekivex UI compares with Material UI and Chakra on bundle size, theming, accessibility, and headless flexibility — with guidance on when to pick which.
- [Tree-Shakeable, Headless Components: The Tekivex UI Design System](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/tekivex-ui-headless-design-system): Tekivex UI ships headless primitives with zero runtime dependencies and tree-shakeable ESM. Here is the design-system philosophy and how to compose it.
- [Building Accessible Forms with Tekivex UI Primitives](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/tekivex-ui-accessible-forms): Accessible forms are hard: labels, error states, ARIA, focus management. Tekivex UI’s form toolkit handles them so you ship WCAG-compliant forms faster.
- [The Tekivex Stack: How the Products Fit Together](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/tekivex-stack-how-products-fit): GridStorm, Tekivex UI, and Quantum Vault are designed to compose. Here is how the pieces fit into one application stack.
- [Why Tekivex Products Are Free to Use: No Paywall, No Per-Seat Fees](https://www.tekivex.com/use-cases/tekivex-mit-open-source-model): No enterprise tier, no paywall, no per-seat fees — every Tekivex product is free to use, including commercially. Here is the reasoning and what it means for your team.

## Free in-browser tools (no upload — files stay on the visitor's device)
- [Merge PDF](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/merge-pdf): Combine several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
- [Split PDF](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/split-pdf): Extract pages or page ranges from a PDF into a new file.
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Turn JPG and PNG images into a single PDF document.
- [Compress PDF](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/compress-pdf): Shrink scanned or image-heavy PDFs to a smaller file size.
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Turn each page of a PDF into a downloadable image.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/rotate-pdf): Rotate the pages of a PDF and save the result.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/remove-pages-pdf): Remove unwanted pages from a PDF and keep the rest.
- [CSV to Chart](https://www.tekivex.com/tools/csv-to-chart): Paste or drop a CSV and get a clean, downloadable chart.
